newsitem.title: USA: Scientific Games says board oks shr buyback.
newsitem.headline: Scientific Games says board oks shr buyback.

text.p: Scientific Games Holdings Corp said Monday its board has approved the purchase of up to 15 percent or about 1.8 million shares of its common stock.
The company said the purchases are to be made in the open market over the next twelve months.
The company said it has about 12.2 million outstanding shares of common stock following the repurchase of about 1.2 million shares in the open market during the past ten months.
Cash on hand and borrowing facilities will be available for the purchases.
The purchased shares may be retired or used for general corporate purposes. The timing of the purchases and the number of shares to be purchased will be dependent on future market conditions.
